dream: On the seventh night, King Arthur dreamt of a stone that bled light beneath a red moon. A hooded voice said: the blade answers only to the one who speaks these words: {words}. In the margin, Merlin scribbled HVWA{c10s3_but_n0_c1g4r} and laughed.

knights.name: Sir Lancelot
knights.note: Undefeated at the joust. Defeated by every door that says pull.

knights.name: Sir Gawain
knights.note: Strongest at noon. Asks for every audience to be scheduled at noon.

knights.name: Sir Percival
knights.note: Still looking for the Grail. Has found four spoons.

knights.name: Sir Galahad
knights.note: Pure of heart. Reads the terms and conditions.

knights.name: Sir Bedivere
knights.note: Keeps the court's records. Keeps the court's grudges too.

knights.name: Sir Kay
knights.note: Steward of the kitchens. Seneschal of the snacks.

knights.name: Sir Tristan
knights.note: Plays the harp. Nobody asked him to.

knights.name: Sir Gareth
knights.note: Started in the kitchens. Never lets anyone forget it.

knights.name: Sir Bors
knights.note: Saw the Grail once. Tells you about it twice an hour.

knights.name: Sir Lamorak
knights.note: Third-best jouster. Mentions it in every introduction.

knights.name: Sir Ector
knights.note: Raised the King. Still calls him 'the boy'.
The Siege Perilous. Reserved for the chosen one. Sitting in it uninvited is not recommended.
